scoring_justification: Cannot recompute M and total polarization from raw dimer polarizations without DFT; compare agent's reported values to paper gold with generous tolerances.

required.M: object containing float fields M11, M22, M23, M32, M33
required.intra_site_coefficients: object containing list-of-3-floats fields P1xx, P1yy, P1zz, P1xy, P1xz, P1yz

outputs.description: Reproduced inter-site polarization matrix M and intra-site coefficients for the MnI2 spin dimer.
Total ferroelectric polarization vectors from direct DFT for the two commensurate helical spin-spiral states.

output_contract.notes: The total polarization computation uses direct DFT supercell calculations; the gKNB model prediction from the extracted coefficients should be consistent, but only the direct DFT values are scored. Verifier compares each component with paper-reported references using tolerances appropriate for toolchain differences.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold M matrix elements and intra-site coefficients from Eq.5, and total polarization vectors from Fig.2.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported values in text and supplementary materials.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the published paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Verified against the paper's cited numbers and units.

expected.units_note: M in 10^-5 eÅ, intra in 10^-6 eÅ
